ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: National AML/CFT framework: Law on Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing No. 14/2022/QH15 dated 14 December 2022 (effective 1 March 2023); Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP dated 28 April 2023 detailing preventive anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing measures; Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN dated 4 July 2023 of the State Bank of Vietnam on AML/CFT obligations of reporting entities; UBO identification and reporting obligations derived from Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration; foreign investment admission governed by Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or corporate registry of the parent's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors / General Meeting of Shareholders of the parent company

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport / immigration authority of the holder's state
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in issuance jurisdiction followed by Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization; certified copies must be re-notarized before a Vietnamese notary public

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence on all foreign and domestic politically exposed persons under Article 8 of Law 14/2022/QH15 and Article 9 of Decree 19/2023/ND-CP; mandatory screening of all UBOs, legal representatives, authorized signatories and capital contributors against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions lists, EU consolidated lists, Vietnamese Ministry of Public Security terrorism designation lists and State Bank of Vietnam compliance alerts before any filing or capital disbursement; obligation to implement a Customer Risk Rating System for the Medium_Risk_Enhanced holding-SPV tier, ongoing transaction monitoring, and maintenance of KYC records for at least 5 years post-relationship, including source-of-wealth documentation for each 25%-or-more beneficial owner.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal (Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp) – https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under Articles 37 through 42 of Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and Articles 15 through 20 of Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP, the enterprise name must comprise the legal entity type designation 'CÔNG TY TNHH' for a limited liability company, followed by a proper name written in Vietnamese script. The proper name may use Vietnamese alphabet letters, digits, the letters F, J, Z, W, and the symbol '@'. A foreign-derived proper name must be phonetically transliterated into Vietnamese; the original foreign-language name may be included in parentheses after the Vietnamese name. The proper name must contain at least two characters excluding the type designation, must not be identical or confusingly similar to any enterprise already registered on the National Business Registration Portal, and must not violate national historical, cultural, moral or social traditions.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Names identical or confusingly similar to an enterprise already registered on the National Business Registration Portal
'BỘ' (Ministry) and names of other state administrative agencies
'VIỆT NAM' / 'VIET NAM' as the proper name of a foreign-invested enterprise without specific authorization of a competent authority
'TẬP ĐOÀN' (Group / Conglomerate) — requires satisfaction of statutory conditions
'TỔNG CÔNG TY' (General Corporation / State Corporation) — restricted to state-owned statutory entities
'NGÂN HÀNG' (Bank), 'BẢO HIỂM' (Insurance), 'CHỨNG KHOÁN' (Securities) — regulated tokens requiring separate sectoral licensing
Words and symbols contrary to national historical traditions, culture, ethics and social customs
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Vietnamese law does not provide a standalone name pre-reservation procedure; the proposed name is examined upon filing of the enterprise registration dossier on the National Business Registration Portal. If the competent Business Registration Office under the Department of Planning and Investment rejects the name, it must issue a written notice stating the grounds pursuant to Article 28 of Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP. The applicant may (i) rectify the dossier by substituting a compliant name and re-submitting within three working days; or (ii) file an administrative complaint with the Director of the Department of Planning and Investment under the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13 within 90 days of the rejection notification; and thereafter (iii) pursue further administrative appeal to the Ministry of Planning and Investment or initiate an administrative case before the competent People's Court within 30 days following the decision on the administrative complaint.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as a standalone statutory head office. Article 43 of Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 requires the LLC to maintain its registered head office in Viet Nam at a physical address where official legal correspondence is served and records are accessible to regulatory inspection. A mail-forwarding virtual office alone is insufficient and will be treated as a shell-company risk trigger under the state 'paper company' (công ty ma) crackdown. A co-working or shared service address may be accepted only where the address provider is a lawfully operating enterprise with a demonstrable lease and genuine administrative reception capability. For a passive equity-holding SPV classified Medium_Risk_Enhanced, the registered office must be supported by a lease agreement, utility bills, personnel attendance records and inspection readiness.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High — approximately 65% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection by the tax authority, business registration agency or public security within the first 24 months of operation, driven by the Government's program against shell enterprises and enhanced AML surveillance on passive holding structures; the SPV must maintain its charter, statutory books, vouchers, meeting minutes and physical reception capability at the registered address at all times.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Articles 46-83 on limited liability companies; Articles 26-33 on lawful representatives and Charter content; Article 75 on capital contribution timelines); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 (Articles 22, 27, 30 and 37-38 for foreign investment, non-conditional sectors and Investment Registration Certificate); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration (Articles 25-32 on application forms, dossier handling, public disclosure and seal specimens); Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP implementing the Law on Investment (Articles 24-27 and 36-44 on investment registration procedures and dossiers); Circular No. 01/2021/TT-BKHĐT (enterprise registration forms); Circular No. 03/2021/TT-BKHĐT (investment registration forms).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province or centrally-run city where the registered office is located, operating the National Enterprise Registration Portal and the National Foreign Investment Information System under the supervision of the Ministry of Planning and Investment (MPI).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form I-1 per Circular No. 01/2021/TT-BKHĐT) submitted via the National Enterprise Registration Portal, preceded by the Application for Investment Registration (Form A.1/A.3 per Circular No. 03/2021/TT-BKHĐT) issued to a foreign-invested limited liability company; both instruments must bear the lawful representative's digital signature or authenticated electronic signature.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to a non-conditional foreign-invested limited liability company (Law on Enterprises 2020, Article 37(1)); for an ISIC 6420 pure equity holding SPV no sector-specific capital threshold is triggered under Law on Investment 2020 Article 27, hence the Charter may declare a commercially reasonable charter capital. The declared charter capital must be fully contributed by wire transfer into the Company's direct investment capital account (DICA) at a State Bank of Vietnam licensed bank within 90 days from the Enterprise Registration Certificate issuance date (Law on Enterprises 2020, Article 75(1)); foreign exchange and DICA opening procedures are governed by State Bank of Vietnam Circular No. 06/2019/TT-NHNN and Law on Foreign Exchange No. 03/1997/QH9. Any unpaid portion after the 90-day period must be rectified by a Members' Council resolution adjusting the contribution schedule, or by reduction of charter capital, with the resulting changes registered with the DPI.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FORMAL FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF THE MEMBERS' COUNCIL OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY (VIET NAM)

A. RECITALS
1. The founding member(s) have agreed to establish [Company Name] Limited Liability Company (the Company) as a foreign-invested limited liability company under Article 46 et seq. of the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and the Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14.
2. The investment project named Pure Equity Holding SPV has been approved by the Department of Planning and Investment of [Province/City] as evidenced by Investment Registration Certificate No. [--] dated [--] (the IRC).
3. The draft Charter, the capital contribution schedule and the proposed registered office have been circulated to all members, and the Members' Council is duly convened.

B. RESOLUTION
1. Adoption of Charter and Share Capital. The Company Charter, as attached, is adopted in full. The charter capital is fixed at VND [--] (in words: [--]), subscribed and payable by each member in accordance with Schedule 1. All contributions must be paid in full within 90 days from the Enterprise Registration Certificate issuance date (Article 75, Law on Enterprises 2020). Contributions shall be remitted to the direct investment capital account opened with a state-licensed commercial bank in compliance with State Bank of Vietnam regulations.
2. Registered Office. The registered office of the Company is adopted at [full street address, ward, district, province/city], Viet Nam. The lawful representative is authorised to accept the office lease, procure the use-right documents, and notify the DPI of the address.
3. Officer Appointments. The following officers are appointed, each to hold office upon issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate: (a) [Name] as Chairperson of the Members' Council; (b) [Name] as lawful representative and General Director/Chief Executive Officer; (c) [Name] as Chief Accountant (if applicable).
4. Banking and Escrow. The Chairperson and the General Director are jointly authorised to open bank accounts, the direct investment capital account, and any escrow account designated by the licensed bank for the holding of unpaid charter capital contributions.
5. Authorisations. The General Director is irrevocably authorised, until revoked by a later Members' Council resolution, to execute and submit the Application for Enterprise Registration, to procure the corporate seal and declare the seal specimen, to register tax identification codes, to sign all incorporation ancillary agreements, and to publish the Company's information on the National Enterprise Registration Portal within 30 working days of ERC issuance.
6. Internal Governance and Dividend Flows. The first ordinary Members' Council meeting shall be convened within 60 days of ERC issuance to adopt dividend distribution, transfer pricing documentation, and intercompany treasury procedures consistent with the passive holding purpose of the Company.

C. EFFECTIVENESS
This Resolution is effective immediately as of [date] and shall be recorded in the corporate minute book.

Adopted by unanimous/consent vote of the Members' Council on [date] at [location].

Chairperson of the Members' Council
Name: [--]
Signature: [--]

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Document preparation, consular legalization and notarization of foreign investor credentials
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Consular Section of the Embassy/Consulate of Viet Nam in the investor's home jurisdiction (consular legalization or apostille) and a licensed Vietnamese notary public under the Law on Notarization No. 11/2014/QH13
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain legalized or apostilled certificates of incorporation and passport copies for each foreign corporate or individual member; arrange certified Vietnamese translations through a licensed translation service; have both the originals and translations notarized by a Vietnamese notary public; execute a conditional office-lease agreement for the prospective registered office address with a clear description of the premises and landlord legal capacity; verify that all notarized documents will remain valid and unexpired at the date of DPI submission.
required_dossiers: Legalized/apostilled certificate of incorporation and articles of association of each foreign corporate member
Notarized passport copies of authorized signatories and individual founding members
Certified Vietnamese translations of all foreign-language corporate documents
Draft lease or sublease agreement for the registered office address
Draft Charter and capital contribution schedule for review
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI or a bank queries expired legalization dates, defective translations or incomplete notarization, obtain fresh legalization, re-translated and re-notarized documents at the investor's cost; if the registered office address is rejected as non-compliant, substitute an alternative lawful address and amend the lease prior to filing the IRC application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) application and approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province or centrally-run city of the registered office, via the online National Foreign Investment Information System or the national single-window investment registration portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Application for Investment Registration (Form A.1/A.3 per Circular No. 03/2021/TT-BKHĐT) for a non-conditional passive holding project. Attach the notarized corporate credentials, the registered office lease, the project description confirming that the SPV will only hold equity interests of subsidiaries, receive dividends and perform treasury/cash-management functions. Because ISIC 6420 is not on the conditional business list (Law on Investment 2020, Article 27) and no investment policy approval is required (Article 30), the DPI will issue the IRC directly. The IRC records the project name, the SPV's legal status, charter capital, and the registered office address.
required_dossiers: Application for Investment Registration (Form A.1/A.3)
Consular-legalized and notarized corporate credentials of all foreign investors
Project description and business plan of the holding SPV
Registered office lease agreement or land use-right evidence
Statement of financial capacity (bank credit confirmation or audited financial statements)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is incomplete, the DPI must issue a written notice of required amendments within 3 business days, after which the investor has 30 days to supplement the dossier; if the application is refused, re-submit a cured dossier; if the DPI exceeds the statutory 15 working-day deadline, lodge a formal complaint under the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13 or petition the Ministry of Planning and Investment for an administrative remedy.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) application via the National Enterprise Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) - National Enterprise Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of the IRC date, file the Application for Enterprise Registration (Form I-1) on the National Enterprise Registration Portal. Upload the Charter signed by all members, the list of founding members and lawful representatives (Forms I-2 and I-3), the IRC, the notarized credentials, and the office lease. Select the entity type of limited liability company, enter ISIC code 6420 (activities of holding companies), declare charter capital in Vietnamese dong, and complete electronic signing using a digital certificate or authenticated SMS/OTP. Pay the VND 50,000 registration fee online. The tax identification number is issued automatically upon issuance of the ERC.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form I-1)
Company Charter signed by all founding members
List of founding members and lawful representatives (Forms I-2/I-3)
Investment Registration Certificate
Notarized and consular-legalized passports and corporate licenses of members
Registered office lease agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a notice of amendment within 3 working days, correct the identified fields and re-submit within the prescribed grace period; if the ERC is refused, lodge a complaint with the Director of the DPI or initiate an administrative court action; any failure of the DPI to act within the statutory period entitles the applicant to a written explanation and remedies under the Law on Enterprises 2020.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) opening and charter capital contribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A commercial bank licensed by the State Bank of Vietnam to operate direct investment capital accounts, with the corporate file assessed under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH13
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the IRC, ERC, Charter, Members' Council resolution and seal specimen declaration to the bank's corporate onboarding desk. Complete the AML/KYC questionnaire and beneficial-ownership declaration. Open the direct investment capital account (DICA) designated for foreign equity remittances and dividend repatriation. After activation, each foreign member wires its subscribed capital through the DICA within the mandatory 90-day window. Any unpaid capital after 90 days must be addressed by a Members' Council resolution revising the contribution schedule or reducing the charter capital, and the banking documentation must be updated accordingly.
required_dossiers: Investment Registration Certificate
Enterprise Registration Certificate
Company Charter and Members' Council resolution on capital contribution
Corporate seal specimen declaration
Passport and authorization documents for bank signatories
AML/KYC forms and beneficial-owner declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises enhanced KYC objections, provide additional beneficial-ownership evidence and refreshed board resolutions; if the target bank declines the file, approach an alternative SBV-licensed bank; if the 90-day contribution deadline lapses, convene the Members' Council to adopt a revised contribution schedule, notify the DPI and the tax authority, and re-register the capital structure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate seal creation, seal specimen declaration and tax activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment via the National Enterprise Registration Portal (seal specimen registration); provincial tax office and General Department of Taxation (tax code activation, e-filing and e-invoices)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Procure a corporate seal from a licensed seal engraving enterprise in Viet Nam. Under Article 32 of Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP, the Company declares the seal specimen through the National Enterprise Registration Portal before the seal is first used; upload the seal specimen form and retrieve the official registration record. File the initial corporate income tax, value-added tax and resident registration files with the local tax authority. If the SPV later issues invoices, register for e-invoicing on the General Department of Taxation portal under Decree No. 123/2020/ND-CP and obtain a digital signature certificate for statutory filings.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Investment Registration Certificate
Corporate seal specimen declaration form
Corporate seal
Tax registration forms and company identity documents
Digital signature certificate for electronic filing and e-invoicing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the seal specimen declaration is rejected, correct the technical errors and re-declare; if the tax code is not activated, contact the responsible tax officer in writing with the ERC and request activation; any defect in the seal production certificate is cured by applying to the local Public Security service for rectification or a reissued seal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Public disclosure, post-registration notices and corporate-governance record keeping
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Enterprise Registration Portal (publication); Department of Planning and Investment (post-registration change notices); provincial tax and social insurance agencies (employee-related registrations, if staff are engaged)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 working days of the ERC, publish the Company's name, address, charter capital, members and lawful representatives on the National Enterprise Registration Portal. Notify the DPI in writing of any subsequent change in officers, charter capital, registered address or members within 10 days. Maintain the corporate minute book, contribution register, and accounting records in accordance with Articles 10-12 and 26 of the Law on Enterprises 2020. If the SPV engages even a single employee with a labor contract, register with the social insurance agency within 30 days of the first contract and file occupational safety declarations under Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH13.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Notice of change of lawful representative / members (if applicable)
Corporate minute book and contribution register
Labor contracts and social insurance registration forms (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the publication deadline is missed, publish immediately and regularize any administrative fines under Decree No. 50/2016/ND-CP as amended by Decree No. 140/2018/ND-CP; for late post-registration changes, submit a correction notice to the DPI to align the public register; for late social insurance registration, settle the contributions plus statutory interest and request a sanction waiver from the social insurance agency.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable. A passive equity-holding SPV classified under ISIC 6420 does not engage in manufacturing, processing or industrial production, and therefore no industrial licensing board authorization is triggered. The Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT) and provincial industrial management authorities regulate conditional manufacturing and trading sectors under Law on Investment 2020 Article 27 and Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP; none of those conditional lines apply to equity holding, treasury management, or dividend collection.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required. The Investment Registration Certificate together with the Enterprise Registration Certificate constitute the full statutory operating authorization for the holding SPV. No sector-specific operating licence, manufacturing permit, export-import licence, or conditional business licence is required for ISIC 6420 passive equity holding, dividend collection and internal accounting activities of the group.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vietnam Environment Administration (VEA) under the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE); provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) supervises local compliance for office-based activities.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Group IV - no EIA and no environmental permit required. Office-only holding SPV activities do not fall within the EIA, environmental license or environmental registration categories under the Law on Environmental Protection No. 72/2020/QH13 and Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP (Annexes II, III and IV). If the registered office is located within an existing commercial/office building, the landlord's building-level environmental registration and discharge permits cover the common systems.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: The premises generate only domestic/sanitary wastewater discharged to municipal sewers, subject to QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT (domestic wastewater standard); no industrial process wastewater, no point-source VOC emissions, and no hazardous waste generation arise from the passive holding function. Solid waste, including office paper and electronic waste, must be sorted and transferred in accordance with Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP and the Law on Environmental Protection 2020; interior noise and vibration must comply with QCVN 26:2010/BTNMT; office electrical and HVAC equipment must conform to energy efficiency rules under the Law on Economical and Efficient Use of Energy No. 50/2010/QH12.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: the Company must verify that its leased premises are covered by the building owner's fire-safety certificate issued under the Fire Prevention and Fighting and Rescue Law No. 27/2001/QH10 (as amended by Law No. 40/2013/QH14) and Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP prior to occupancy; if the future office exceeds the threshold for high-risk premises under Annex III of Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP, the Company must obtain a police fire-safety appraisal and an operational fire-safety certificate from the Fire Police (C07). Occupational safety and health: the Company, if it hires employees, must carry out workplace risk assessments, provide safety training, and file labor-usage declarations with the provincial Department of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs under the Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH13 and Decree No. 39/2016/ND-CP; structural load and worker-density clearance for the office floor is the responsibility of the building owner as evidenced by the building's operational certificate; no additional civil-defense clearance is required for a non-industrial office-funded holding entity.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế), Ministry of Finance, Socialist Republic of Vietnam; official electronic tax portal: https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn (e-tax declaration, e-invoice data transmission, and online tax payment); enterprise registration integrated portal: https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn; national public administrative service portal: https://dichvucong.gov.vn
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned LLC must obtain, in sequential order: (i) the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC – Giấy chứng nhận đăng ký đầu tư) from the provincial Management Board / Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) under the Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14; and (ii) the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC – Giấy chứng nhận đăng ký doanh nghiệp) under the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14. Upon ERC issuance, the National Business Registration Database automatically generates the enterprise's 10-digit Tax Identification Number (TIN – Mã số thuế, MST) without a separate application; the TIN is simultaneously synchronized to the General Department of Taxation's master taxpayer database. Post-registration, the LLC must complete the supplementary tax registration declaration (Form 01-ĐK-TCT) electronically on the GDT e-tax portal, file a bank account notification (Form 09-ĐK-TCT), register the electronic signature of the legal representative, and open a direct investment capital account (DICA) at a licensed commercial bank for inward foreign equity contributions and outward repatriation. There is no separate VAT ID in Vietnam: the single MST is the universal tax identifier governing CIT, VAT, foreign contractor tax obligations, import/export customs codes, and social insurance declarations. For LLCs in export processing zones (EPE) the same TIN registration applies, with additional customs-related registration on the VNACCS/VCIS customs platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; a resident Vietnamese LLC is an independent taxpayer wholly subject to the Law on Corporate Income Tax No. 14/2008/QH12 (as amended by Laws 32/2013/QH13 and 71/2014/QH13), with a standard CIT rate of 20%; no pass-through, transparent, or flow-through fiscal status is recognized for Vietnamese LLCs. The LLC is taxed on worldwide income with a foreign tax credit mechanism; domestic inter-corporate dividends (dividends received from Vietnamese resident operating companies) are exempt from CIT (shareholding participation exemption), but interest income from loan receivables and capital gains on transfer of equity interests in non-publicly-traded targets are taxable at 20%; for portfolio/index-listed securities the deemed tax rate is 0.1% of gross proceeds. Foreign-source dividends received from an overseas subsidiary are taxable at the standard 20% rate subject to any applicable Vietnam double-taxation treaty relief and the foreign tax credit regime. A pure equity-holding SPV (ISIC 6420) does not automatically qualify for any tax-exempt-zone concession; EPE/high-tech-zone concessions apply only to manufacturing or qualifying high-tech activities, not to passive holding income.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vietnam's fiscal framework contains no check-the-box, consolidated-group filing, fiscal unity, or hybrid-mismatch elections under domestic CIT law. The legally available elections are: (1) loss carrying-forward and timing election — tax losses may be carried forward up to 5 consecutive years, with the enterprise electing which profitable year to offset first (Circular 78/2014/TT-BTC, Article 11); (2) depreciation method election among straight-line, declining balance, and units-of-production, subject to circular 45/2013/TT-BTC; (3) transfer-pricing election to apply the transactional net margin method, CUP, or TNMM with corresponding Director of Taxation approval; (4) unilateral/bilateral/multilateral Advance Pricing Agreement application with GDT and competent-tax-authority mutual agreement procedure access; and (5) a one-time irrevocable election by successor entities in qualifying cross-border asset reorganisation deals to adopt deemed asset/tax-basis rollover, pursuant to Circular 78/2014 read with Decree 218/2013. Foreign tax credits are mandatory (credit method) — no deduction election exists; the LLC can elect between the credit amount computed under the foreign jurisdiction's final liability or an equivalent preferential-low-tax regime, without entitling to excessive foreign tax credit beyond Vietnamese CIT at 20%.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT – Thuế Giá Trị Gia Tăng) under the Law on VAT No. 13/2008/QH12, as amended by Laws 31/2013/QH13 and 71/2014/QH13, guided by Decree 209/2013/ND-CP and Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC, with invoicing and administration rules under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VND 1,000,000,000 (one billion Vietnamese Dong) of annual taxable revenue; nevertheless, a foreign-invested LLC acting as a pure equity-holding SPV is compulsorily registered as a VAT taxpayer regardless of turnover, since only households and individuals with annual revenue not exceeding VND 100,000,000 may elect VAT-exempt status; voluntary VAT registration is permitted downwards to business assurance; registration is effectuated via the integrated TIN/ERC process and will encompass all Vietnamese taxable supplies, making the HoldCo liable to maintain VAT books and e-invoices from inception (Circular 105/2021/TT-BTC, Decree 209/2013)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory and comprehensive e-invoicing regime under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC applies to every registered business, including holding SPVs. Each e-invoice must contain a standardized invoice code, a secure 2-to-6 digit verification code, a QR code, and a valid digital signature (hardware token, HSM, or certified remote signing). Two issuance modes exist: (i) invoices with tax-authority-issued invoice code (VAT code) generated through the GDT e-invoice portal and (ii) self-generated invoices without pre-issued authorisation on the basis of a registered invoice template. The issuer must transmit the XML invoice data to the GDT's consolidated e-invoice database no later than 12 hours from issuance, with large enterprises required to implement API-based real-time or near-real-time data synchronization under the Phase-2 e-invoice roadmap; there is no physical seal or stamp — fiscal clearance is wholly electronic. All e-invoice data is conservatively used by GDT for automated cross-matching of input VAT deductions and output VAT declarations; any mismatch, delayed transmission, or non-issuance triggers an automatic VAT-refund blockage and administrative warnings, and can suspend the LLC's VAT refund eligibility until rectification and penalties are settled.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For a pure-equity holding SPV (ISIC 6420), the 0% export VAT rate is inherently inapplicable to its typical revenue streams: dividends, loan interest, and equity-transfer capital gains fall outside the VAT taxable scope and are thus neither 0% nor refundable under Article 9 of Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC. The SPV may claim 0% export VAT only if it separately undertakes qualifying export transactions, namely: (i) export of tangible goods with a valid electronic customs export declaration on VNACCS/VCIS and actual physical export of goods from Vietnam; (ii) sale of goods to Vietnamese export processing enterprises (EPE) which are classified as exports under Vietnam's 'no free-circulation zone' customs treatment; or (iii) supply of services to a foreign entity where the services are entirely consumed outside Vietnam (offshore services), including services to foreign contractors performing overseas construction or installation; to sustain 0% on offshore services the LLC must evidence the non-resident contracting counterparty, the place of performance outside Vietnamese customs territory, and negligible domestic consumption. Reinvoicing of intra-group management fees or cost-plus service resilience without an offshore consumption chain cannot be re-characterized as 0% supplies. The input VAT attributable to the SPV's overheads (that is not allocated to exempt dividend income) is deductible only under the credit-method, with output-side zero-rating claims reviewed strictly.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Electronic Customs Export Declaration (Tờ khai Hải quan hàng hóa xuất khẩu) duly registered on the VNACCS/VCIS system with a customs barcode

Bill of Lading (Original or Electronic Non-Negotiable Waybill for sea freight / Air Waybill for air cargo) or, for cross-border land export, the internationally recognized Road Consignment Note / Customs Typical Transit Document
Commercial Invoice and detailed Packing List reflecting shipment particulars and export incoterms
Foreign Trade Contract / International Sale Agreement (or for service export: the Offshore Service Agreement, service completion certificate and Client's written confirmation of offshore consumption)
Certificate of Origin (C/O) Form E, Form D, or ordinary C/O as required by destination market
Insurance Policy/Certificate when CIF/CIP terms apply, endorsing the foreign buyer as beneficiary where appropriate

Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) issued by a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank or a foreign-currency bank statement evidencing actual receipt of export proceeds from the overseas counterparty into the LLC's DICA
Export e-invoice with zero-rate (0%) output VAT code issued in accordance with the GDT e-invoice portal
Customs invoice / packing list reconciliation sheet and log of container tracking (M&A of documentary completeness under Articles 15-17 Circular 119/2014/TT-BTC consolidated by Circular 22/2014)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating and VAT-refund dossiers of holding SPVs are referred to enhanced desk and field audit by the General Department of Taxation (tax risk management unit) and General Department of Customs (post-clearance audit), given passive holding entities' natural non-export character. Fraudulent or abusive zero-rating claims attract: (i) administrative tax penalties of 1 to 3 times the evaded tax amount, plus late-payment interest at 0.03% per day for every overdue day and a freeze of any pending refund setoff (Law on Tax Administration 38/2019, Articles 33, 34, 58 and 59; Decree 125/2020/ND-CP, Article 17); (ii) retrospective clawback of refunds and input-credit disallowance for an audit period, with the statute of limitation reaching 5 years for ordinary tax administration and extending to 10 years where fraudulent intent is established; (iii) criminal prosecution for tax evasion per Article 200 of the Penal Code 2015 (as amended) — imprisonment of up to 7 years where the evaded amount exceeds VND 100 million or the total false-invoice amount exceeds VND 7.5 billion, plus fines up to 4.5 times the evaded amount, and seizure/confiscation of property; (iv) cross-administrative sanctions including revocation of the LLC's VAT-invoice issuance status, suspension of the ERC/IRC certificate registration, publication of the taxpayer's non-compliance status under Decree 125/2020; and (v) blacklisting of the legal representative and chief accountant as tax-delinquent individuals, thereby blocking issuance of travel-exit visas for repeat offenders. E-invoice data that is not transmitted, or invoices with unverified counterparties in the GDT database, are automatically de-matched, causing the input VAT shown on zero-rated exports to be voided and recoverable only after a full document-verification pre-refund audit, which generally precedes around 70% of all refund applications; the LLC's bank mandate verification through the IRC must evidence funds physically repatriated within 180 days before refund clearance is granted.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Fee declaration and payment (Lệ phí môn bài) – fixed annual tax assessed on registered charter capital
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department (Cục Thuế) under the General Department of Taxation, at the SPV's registered address
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 31 of each calendar year; newly incorporated LLCs pay within 30 days from Enterprise Registration Certificate issuance or by December 31 of the establishment year, whichever is earlier
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest of 0.03% per day under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP; administrative fines of VND 2,000,000–10,000,000 for late filing or under-declaration; persistent non-payment triggers enforced tax collection, bank remittance hold, and risk of administrative revocation of the Enterprise Registration Certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Quarterly provisional Corporate Income Tax (CIT) return and prepayment (Tờ khai thuế TNDN tạm tính)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department (Cục Thuế) under the General Department of Taxation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 30th day after each calendar quarter-end: Q1 – April 30; Q2 – July 30; Q3 – October 30; Q4 – January 30 of the following year (for the statutory January–December fiscal year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fine of VND 4,000,000–8,000,000 per return; 0.03% daily interest on any unpaid provisional CIT; understated provisional payments are reconciled in the annual finalization and may trigger a full tax audit of intercompany holdings and dividend flows.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Periodic VAT return – nil-declaration (Tờ khai thuế GTGT) for a passive equity holding entity with no reportable VAT transactions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department (Cục Thuế) under the General Department of Taxation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Quarterly filers (annual revenue below VND 50 billion): January 30, April 30, July 30, and October 30 following each quarter; monthly filers: 20th day of the following month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines of VND 4,000,000–8,000,000; 0.03% daily interest on any assessed VAT; chronic non-filing of nil returns may cause the tax authority to classify the SPV as inactive and support DPI de-registration proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual CIT finalization return (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN) covering exempt dividend income and deductible holding-period expenses
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department (Cục Thuế) under the General Department of Taxation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: March 31 (within 90 days after the statutory fiscal year-end of December 31)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Incremental late-filing fines under Article 13, Decree 125/2020/ND-CP: VND 4,000,000 for up to 90 days overdue, escalating to VND 25,000,000 beyond 180 days; 0.03% daily interest on unpaid CIT; absence of finalization blocks issuance of tax compliance certificates required for foreign dividend remittance and loan registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited annual financial statements (Báo cáo tài chính năm đã kiểm toán) prepared under VAS and audited by a licensed Vietnamese audit firm
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department (Cục Thuế) and provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) – Business Registration Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after December 31 (i.e., March 31); audited statements must accompany the CIT finalization dossier and be filed with the DPI as the annual corporate registration report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-submission to the DPI: administrative fine of VND 10,000,000–15,000,000 under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; rejected or late audited statements invalidate the tax finalization, disallow intercompany expense deductions, and two consecutive years of omission expose the LLC to administrative strike-off (DPI revocation of the Enterprise Registration Certificate).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual enterprise registration information report and change notification (Thông báo thay đổi nội dung đăng ký doanh nghiệp) for members, capital structure, legal representative, and address
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI), Business Registration Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 10 days after any change in members, charter capital, legal representative, or registered office; audited financial statements filed with the DPI by March 31 serve as the annual information refresh
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines of VND 10,000,000–15,000,000 for failure to notify member or charter-capital changes; registration data mismatches block cross-border dividend remittances and intercompany lending; persistent false or omitted declarations constitute a statutory ground for revocation (strike-off) of the Enterprise Registration Certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory Register of Members and beneficial-owner annual confirmation (KYC/AML refresh) for banking and corporate record purposes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: No government filing receipt – register maintained at the registered office and presented on demand to licensed corporate agents, custodian banks, tax authorities, and AML inspection bodies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Register of Members must be updated within 7 days of any capital-contribution transfer; annual banking UBO KYC confirmation submitted to the SPV's corporate bank in Q1 of each year or upon any ownership change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: False or incomplete member/UBO declarations attract administrative fines up to VND 30,000,000 and AML sanctions under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering 2022; banking KYC failure suspends outward remittances and dividend wires; aggravated cases may trigger administrative strike-off by the DPI.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual labor utilization report (Báo cáo tình hình sử dụng lao động) – nil status for a pure equity holding SPV with no employees
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs (DOLISA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: June 15 of each year; required only if the SPV employs local or foreign staff – a no-employee holding LLC must retain a nil-report evidence trail or file a nil return where DOLISA requires
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or false reporting: administrative fine of VND 2,000,000–5,000,000; no financial impact for a no-staff SPV but non-compliance creates unnecessary inspection risk.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual enterprise statistical survey response (Điều tra doanh nghiệp) issued by the national statistical authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Statistics Office (Cục Thống kê) under the General Statistics Office of Vietnam
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: April 30 of each year (standard survey window February–April); response obligation arises only when the SPV receives the statutory survey form
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to respond or false responses: administrative fine of VND 2,000,000–5,000,000; the SPV remains permanently in the national statistical directory and omission of the return is a continuing violation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Compulsory annual audit applies to all foreign-invested enterprises regardless of size, revenue, or asset thresholds (Law on Independent Audit No. 67/2011/QH12; Decree No. 17/2012/ND-CP, Article 3). A 100% foreign-owned limited liability company structured as a pure equity holding SPV qualifies as a foreign-invested enterprise and cannot rely on domestic micro-enterprise exemptions; its audited VAS financial statements must be filed with the tax authority and the DPI within 90 days of fiscal year-end.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: VAS – Vietnamese Accounting Standards and the enterprise accounting regime under Law on Accounting No. 88/2015/QH13, Circular No. 200/2014/TT-BTC, and Circular No. 133/2016/TT-BTC (SME framework is not available to foreign-invested entities; full Circular 200 regime applies). IFRS under Circular No. 105/2020/TT-BTC is voluntary only for specifically approved unlisted enterprises; a passive holding SPV keeps statutory books and reporting in VAS, with IFRS reconciliation prepared solely for the ultimate parent if contractually required.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam does not impose a standalone annual UBO return on a private LLC. The statutory Register of Members records every capital contribution and transfer and must be updated within 7 days of any transfer under Law on Enterprise 2020, Articles 49–50; any change in members or ownership percentages must be notified to the DPI within 10 days. During the annual banking KYC/AML refresh (Q1), the SPV must certify its direct members and ultimate beneficial owners on the licensed bank's UBO forms, supported by certified ownership chain charts and identity documents. Retention of UBO evidence is required for the duration of the business relationship plus at least 5 years after account closure under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering 2022; failure to evidence the ownership chain blocks foreign dividend remittance and cross-border wires.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Sổ đăng ký thành viên)
Register of Capital Contribution Transfers (Sổ theo dõi chuyển nhượng vốn góp)
Minute Book of the Members' Council and Register of Resolutions (Sổ biên bản và nghị quyết của Hội đồng thành viên)
Register of Director/General Director decisions and DPI correspondence file (Sổ quyết định Giám đốc và hồ sơ thông báo cơ quan đăng ký)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 700 – 1,500 per year for a licensed corporate service provider in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City, covering the physical registered address, mail handling, document receipt, and basic DPI filing support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 – 6,000 per year for a low-transaction pure equity holding LLC audited by a licensed Vietnamese audit firm; an additional USD 1,000 – 2,000 is typical if the ultimate parent requires an IFRS reconciliation pack or consolidated reporting assistance

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 20% (standard rate from 1 January 2016; Small and Medium Enterprises may qualify for a preferential 15% rate under certain conditions, which is irrelevant for a passive holding SPV)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: None for a pure equity holding SPV. Income from dividend derived from shares in another Vietnamese domestic enterprise is excluded from taxable CIT income; it is not a 'tax holiday' but a non-taxable receipt. No applicable statutory tax holiday or investment incentive beyond the standard rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 01/TNDN – Annual Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN) filed electronically via the National Tax Portal (thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn). Quarterly provisional CIT declarations are filed on Form 01A/TNDN.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual finalization; quarterly provisional declarations at end of each quarter. For annual filings, the finalization return and any due tax must be submitted within 90 days after the end of the fiscal year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual finalization return: no later than the 90th day from the end of the fiscal year. Quarterly provisional CIT return: no later than the 30th day after the end of each quarter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue of the tax year (Doanh thu). For the pure equity holding SPV, this includes dividend income, interest income, and any management fees or other receipts. Dividend inflows from Vietnamese resident subsidiaries are typically recorded but separately identified in Line 2.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter all revenue attributable to Vietnamese-source activities of the LLC. For a non-resident-owned LLC, do not include purely offshore revenue of a foreign parent; the LLC files on its own Vietnamese TIN. If dividend income is received, state it here and then exclude in Line 2.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-taxable income (Thu nhập miễn thuế). Includes dividends received from equity investments in other Vietnamese resident enterprises, after deducting directly attributable expenses. Such income is exempt from CIT.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify the shareholding percentage and the declaration of the underlying dividend. The SPV must maintain formal documentation of the shareholding and dividend distribution to claim this exemption. No foreign residency status is relevant for this box; the exemption applies regardless of ultimate shareholder residence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible expenses (Chi phí được trừ). Only actual, documented expenses incurred for the production of taxable income and in compliance with Vietnamese CIT rules are deductible. For a holding SPV, items include legal/accounting fees, banking charges, and interest on financing for the acquisition of holdings.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners must ensure that intercompany expenses (e.g., management fees from a foreign parent) meet the arm's length principle and deductibility criteria under Decree 132/2020 and Circular 96/2015/TT-BTC. Expenses paid to offshore service providers are subject to withholding taxes and must be properly disclosed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income (Thu nhập chịu thuế) = Line 1 – Line 2 – Line 3. The result is the pre-loss tax base. If negative, the amount is a tax loss available for carryforward under Line 5.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a pure equity holding SPV, taxable income will typically be zero due to dividend exclusion, unless the SPV receives interest or other taxable receipts. Non-residents should not net foreign-source expenses against Vietnamese dividend income unless they are allocated to taxable activities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax loss carryforward (Lỗ được kết chuyển). Losses may be carried forward for a maximum of 5 consecutive years from the year following the year the loss arose. No carryback is permitted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign-owned holding SPV may carry forward losses from operating expenses (e.g., bank loan interest) if properly substantiated. Losses related to the acquisition of equity are not deductible for CIT; instead, they are capital losses and may be recognized in the future disposal of shares.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Assessable income (Thu nhập tính thuế) = Line 4 – Line 5. This is the final CIT base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the CIT rate of 20% unless a treaty or incentive changes the rate. For a passive holding SPV, the rate remains 20% on any positive assessable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT rate (Thuế suất thuế TNDN) in percentage. Normally 20%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the LLC is entitled to a preferential rate under law (e.g., high-tech business) the applicable data must be attached. For this SPV, use 20%.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT payable for the year (Thuế TNDN phải nộp) = Line 6 × Line 7. The amount is reduced by any provisional tax already paid in quarterly declarations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If no taxable income, enter zero. Any withholding tax on Vietnamese-source income or foreign contractor tax already paid may be credited against final liability. Non-resident owners are not entitled to file the CIT return on behalf of the LLC; the LLC is the taxpayer.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty ranges from a warning to VND 25 million (approximately USD 1,051) depending on the number of days overdue, as set out in the Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14. Late payment interest accrues at 0.03% per day on the outstanding tax amount. If the return is incorrect causing underpayment, a 20% penalty on the under-declared tax may be imposed; fraudulent conduct leading to tax evasion attracts fines up to 3 times the evaded tax and potential criminal prosecution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% – Vietnam does not impose a separate dividend withholding tax on distributions from a Vietnamese LLC to foreign corporate shareholders. Dividends are paid out of after-tax CIT profits and are not subject to an additional statutory WHT.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Although no dividend WHT is levied, any beneficial owner seeking a reduced treaty rate on interest, royalties, or other payments must file an application with the Vietnamese tax authority using Form 01/NTNN (Foreign Contractor Tax application) and provide the applicable Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the home jurisdiction's tax authority. The TRC must be apostilled or legalized, translated into Vietnamese, and submitted within the prescribed time before or at the time the income is paid. Vietnamese law applies the OECD ‘beneficial owner’ test under the applicable Double Tax Agreement. For interest and royalties, the payment must be made to a resident with the right to receive the income and not a conduit. The taxpayer must prepare documentation confirming arm's length nature and registration of the underlying contract under the electronic foreign contractor tax portal.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates under Vietnam's Foreign Contractor Tax: Interest paid to non-residents is subject to 5% WHT; royalties (including franchise, trademark, patent, and other IP) are subject to 10% WHT. Under most Vietnamese DTAs, interest is reduced to 10% and royalties to 10% (some treaties further reduce certain royalty types to 5%, e.g. copyright royalties for literary/artistic works). The treaty benefit is available only upon submission of a valid TRC and satisfaction of substantive tests.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File (TP documentation) is mandatory where (i) total taxpayer revenue in the year is ≥ VND 50 billion and total related-party transaction value is ≥ VND 1 billion, or (ii) total related-party transaction value is ≥ VND 30 billion regardless of revenue. Master File is mandatory where the ultimate parent’s consolidated annual revenue is ≥ VND 18,000 billion (approximately USD 774 million) or the local taxpayer’s total revenue is ≥ VND 1,000 billion. These thresholds are stated in VND under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP. For a pure equity holding SPV, related-party transactions typically include loans or financing, management fees, share transfer proceeds, and any IP usage; dividends received are not part of the TP transaction base.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: Profit Split Method (including residual profit split)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vietnam does not operate a dedicated Economic Substance Regulation (ESR) regime comparable to the Cayman Islands or BVI. However, Decree 132/2020 and the Law on Tax Administration (Article 19) impose a substance-over-form principle and a general anti-avoidance rule (GAAR). A pure equity holding SPV is required to demonstrate real management and commercial substance in Vietnam: active board meetings in Vietnam, preparation of minutes, strategic decision-making by Vietnamese-based directors, maintenance of local books and records, and appropriate staff/local office arrangements. If a Vietnamese entity is characterized as a low-risk, low-function entity, the tax authority may re-characterize profit allocation, disallow the dividend exclusion, and impose additional CIT plus penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willful omission of income from the CIT finalization, overstatement of deductible expenses, failure to file the annual return, or underpayment of provisional CIT. For a pure holding SPV, this includes failing to report foreign income from share disposals or using the LLC to conceal taxable gains from the transfer of subsidiary shares.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14, fines for tax evasion may reach 3 times the evaded amount. Under the Penal Code (Article 200), tax evasion is a criminal offence: if the evaded amount exceeds VND 100 million, the individual offender can be fined up to VND 4.5 billion or imprisoned for up to 7 years. The company may additionally incur revocation of the business registration certificate and a prohibition on operations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative (Director/Chairman) and compliance officers of the LLC are personally liable for the company's tax debts if they fail to comply with filing or payment duties. Tax authorities may issue travel bans (exit suspension) when a director has a personal or corporate tax arrears above VND 100 million. Criminal prosecution for evasion exposes the director to personal fines, civil restitution, and imprisonment up to 7 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the LLC as a shell with no real office, no employees, no locally resident directors, and bookkeeping conducted entirely abroad, while using the Vietnamese entity to hold subsidiary equity and claim dividend exclusion or treaty benefits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the GAAR, the tax authority may re-characterize the entire corporate structure, deny the CIT non-taxable treatment of dividends, re-allocate income to the actual revenue earner, and impose additional CIT (20%) plus late payment interest at 0.03% per day. Administrative penalties for failure to provide substance documentation are up to VND 50 million; in serious cases the entity may be deemed to be conducting an illicit financial arrangement and the LLC’s tax registration may be revoked.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held jointly and severally liable for the additional tax and penalties. If the shell arrangement is used to facilitate tax evasion or money laundering, personal criminal liability arises. Travel bans can be applied against directors of the shell entity until the tax debt is cleared.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Implementing non-arm's-length cross-border financing, such as excessive interest rates on shareholder loans, off-market management fees paid to a foreign parent, artificial allocation of IP royalties, or avoiding TP documentation thresholds by splitting transactions among Vietnamese affiliates. For a holding SPV, unsubstantiated valuation of the share transfer price on the sale of subsidiary equity is a common fatal impairment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Decree 132/2020, the tax authority may make a TP adjustment, recompute the taxable income, and impose a 20% penalty on the under-declared CIT amount, in addition to late payment interest at 0.03% per day. Failure to submit TP documentation (Local File/Master File) carries a penalty of VND 10–50 million. If intentional TP manipulation constitutes evasion, the criminal penalties prescribed for tax evasion apply.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve or execute TP agreements without supporting economic analysis can be personally assessed for the additional tax debt if their actions were malicious or grossly negligent. They may be barred from leaving Vietnam while the case is pending, and may face criminal charges for false certification of transfer pricing documents.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the SPV as a conduit for transfers of funds without a valid economic purpose, failing to disclose beneficial ownership, accepting incoming wires from unrelated third parties without documentation, or structuring transactions to avoid Vietnamese AML reporting thresholds (VND 300 million, approx. USD 12,800) for significant cash transactions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering (No. 12/2022/QH15) and Penal Code Article 324, money laundering is punishable by up to 15 years' imprisonment for individuals and fines up to VND 5 billion (procedure). Administrative penalties for AML violations may reach VND 200 million. The SPV may have its transaction accounts frozen and its business license suspended.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative, beneficial owners, and compliance officers are subject to criminal prosecution for money laundering if they knew or should have known the source of assets. The corporate veil does not protect directors; they face personal criminal fines, imprisonment, travel bans, and asset forfeiture. Concurrent civil restitution to the victims or the state may be imposed.
